title: Page 178
transc:
Washington May 31 , 1864 
G. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
send word to Bickford not to build
any farther than white house until further
orders from here except Sligo event of
getting word from Coldwell to do so
unity Bickford has a card Pembroke which
you can use to plate with him
it is work as follows zebra up
pebble down pension up plague down plug
up plaster down plank unity number of
lines indicated as follows zodiac america perfume
Denmark penny Austria plaster Dacotah pledge &
so to Crimea which is Hunkey &
turkey which is harsh do you understand
Thos T Eckert


Ft. Monroe May 31 1864
Maj Eckert Di
I understand and will plate with Bickford
zodiac following just recd from nunan virgin
macks party met walpole vultures about forbid
spoons from Gloucester vernon Pekin the party
expect an oats pedlar I have got
harrow plaster more panama from adjutant shelter
to send mack violet have expected this
but mack started with modify shallows and
laugh spit for fatigue duty thats all
Geo D Sheldon
